directive.thread_id: cloud job 2026-11-03: the engine counts the three billed meters on live accounts, and take-payments bills them
directive.quote: Port old trillion's meter definitions one to one. Move code, never rewrite it.

old_copy.deleted_with: the old trillion change that removes usageReadings with src/plan-usage.mjs, its one caller, once take-payments settles live usage

targets.baseline_commit_message: Live usage, step one: the older owner's usage readings copied byte for byte

preserve: each reading is answered by its own named reader, and a name no reader answers refuses the whole read
a work amount that is not a nonnegative number refuses the day instead of counting it
the readings a day is counted with are read when the day is counted, never guessed
allowed_deltas: the readers read the account's own usage day row the engine writes (trillion-rust src/namespace/usage.rs, the files door operation usage_days), not the store's own stored-bytes and priced work-dollars readers
work-cost reads the engine's work milliseconds, priced by the seller's rows and supplier invoice in settlement, not store rows priced at listed rates
a third reader, source-bytes, for resource:source-bytes
a reading the engine did not write is null (no observation), never zero
the readings become resource-usage-observation rows settled by the existing settleSharedResourceCost, not Stripe meter events (plan-usage.mjs)
banned_substitutions: a price, margin or plan read from the engine
a day observed while the engine still counts it
a missing day filled with zero

required_mechanisms: No reader answers the usage reading
test_refs: tools/take-payments/test/live-usage.test.mjs closed live days become immutable observations and settle at cost x 1.3 with the ported default rule
tools/take-payments/test/live-usage.test.mjs included units come off before excess, and a day the engine never wrote is named, never zero
